primary_operator.source: Sadeghi et al. (2026), Journal of Hydrology 673:135467, DOI 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2026.135467
primary_operator.source_form: H(t) = -(1/sqrt(pi)) * integral_0^t dtheta(tau)/sqrt(t-tau), discretized by a sum over all prior moisture increments
primary_operator.mathematical_identification: For absolutely continuous theta, this is the negative of the classical Caputo half-order derivative. This identification is mathematical interpretation; the VZAA paper itself describes H as a half-order derivative.
primary_operator.sign_switch_dependency: VZAA Eq. 6 uses H<=0 versus H>0 to select c_w=0.5 or c_d=2.

candidate_fast_memory_families.literature: Jiang, Zhang, Zhang & Zhang, Fast evaluation of the Caputo fractional derivative, DOI 10.4208/cicp.OA-2016-0136
candidate_fast_memory_families.state_cost: O(N_exp) memory variables per history signal
candidate_fast_memory_families.reason: Published SOE error constructions require N_exp growing approximately logarithmically with T/dt for fixed accuracy as the represented time horizon grows.

candidate_fast_memory_families.literature: Diethelm, A New Diffusive Representation for Fractional Derivatives and convergence analysis, 2022
candidate_fast_memory_families.state_cost: O(M) memory variables for fixed quadrature dimension M, independent of elapsed step count
candidate_fast_memory_families.qualification_limit: A fixed M is an approximation. Error must be demonstrated for the VZAA operator over the admitted timestep and simulation-horizon range; no arbitrary history truncation is permitted.
candidate_fast_memory_families.generic_time: Literature supports arbitrary/nonuniform evaluation grids in principle, but the exact VZAA-derived recurrence still requires implementation and qualification.

hard_qualification_requirements: retain the literal published Eq. 5 history sum as the scientific reference path
support nonuniform generic timesteps without silently replacing the published temporal semantics
compare H value error and H sign classification separately
exercise constant, monotone wetting, monotone drying, pulse, oscillatory and repeated reversal histories
exercise long quiet tails after early moisture changes because the half-order kernel has long memory
checkpoint and rollback all memory variables transactionally
report persistent bytes and operations per layer/history signal
quantify effect of H approximation on c_w/c_d switching, layer flux, mass ledger and groundwater exchange
never classify a bounded-memory approximation as published VZAA

first_executable_gate.name: H0_LITERAL_EQ5_REFERENCE
first_executable_gate.purpose: Build a source-faithful direct full-history evaluator for Eq. 5 on generic nonuniform time grids and verify it against analytic histories where a closed-form half-order derivative exists.
required_discrete_cases: nonuniform monotone grids with deterministic fixed patterns
repeated reversal history for exact direct-sum determinism and sign reporting
first_executable_gate.rule: H0 must not introduce any bounded-memory approximation. It exists to freeze the expensive scientific comparator before H1 candidates are tested.
